Variance Review BoardLink

Review AreaWhat Must Be ComparedWhy It Matters
Planned sell economicsQuoted price, expected gross margin, payment terms, and assumed release timing.Establishes the commercial promise that future pricing might try to reuse.
Realized sell economicsActual invoice value, deductions, payment timing, release condition, and any concession.Confirms whether the win converted into the economics the founder expected.
Supplier-side economicsGarlic cost, supplier settlement timing, quality adjustments, and any payable pressure.Protects the margin story from hidden sourcing or settlement movement.
Logistics economicsFreight, inspection, packet, loading, and timing costs.Prevents operational friction from disappearing inside a clean sales story.
Capital timingDeposit, release exposure, payables release, and working-capital drag.Shows whether the win consumed more cash discipline than its commercial read suggests.
Trust and service costCustomer behavior, response reliability, and service issue exposure.Distinguishes a clean account from a clean margin.

Escalation RulesLink

TriggerRequired MoveReason
Future pricing cites Harbor Fresh before variance closes.Block citation and route founder review to this module.Actual economics must lead pricing memory.

Shipment facts conflict with commercial memory.Reconcile shipment review before closeout.Handoff proof must explain economics, not sit separately.
